ops.name: Fill reservoir S and put it on the dock
ops.where: glovebox or hood, then the tray at the access opening

steps.step: Hand on the reservoir's pull tab (the lid handle carried forward to y -100, z 248..258, in front of the beam tube)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Reservoir S slides out on its dovetail and out through the guard door
steps.detail: free along (0, -125, 0) -> (0, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.85 mm to Metering base (6061, fluted roller over a 100 mm d

steps.step: Fill it in the glovebox (or under argon in a hood): ~80 g per 15 mm build; weigh, close, NFC tag
Slide it back on (the reverse path, checked above); the dock cam opens its shutter

ops.name: Start a build: plate in, door shut, purge, preheat

steps.step: Plate in through the chamber door onto the bayonet (piston at +8 mm)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Close the door and the right draw latch (on the door's right bracket, lever at its front end)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from (-0.5, -0.85, 0)

steps.step: Left draw latch
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Close the guard door (guard lock engages)
Purge: 2-3 vacuum-argon cycles to <= 100 ppm O2 (budgets.py: 2 cycles from 1 mbar, 3 from 10 mbar), then flow
Preheat the plate to 200 C (~15 min ramp on Ø50, README)

ops.name: Finish a build: cool down, raise the plate, take it out, empty the overflow, return powder

steps.step: Cool the plate to < 50 C (door interlock, module_params.T_DOOR_OPEN): ~50 min for Ø50 (preheat-and-plates.md)
Vent to air through the filter; passivation per the cleaning SOP (pain-points P35)
Hand through the chamber door to the plate (plate top at z = +8 mm; hand centre 37 mm above it)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Plate: turned 60 deg off its bayonet, lifted 20 mm (spigot and lugs over the 8 mm door sill), out through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, 20) -> (0, -520, 20); tightest gap 2.0 mm to Heater block S25 (6061-T6, bayonet socket)

steps.step: Fingers on the overflow jar's toggle-clamp lever under the floor (lever end at y -122, z -82)
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: KF-40 toggle clamp opened (one push on the lever) and taken off by hand
steps.detail: by hand; no path check

steps.step: Overflow jar: drop 8 mm off the centring ring, straight out to the front
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, -8) -> (0, -520, -8); tightest gap 0.3 mm to Overflow port (KF-40, weld stub to 40 mm)

steps.step: Sieve (63 um) and return powder in the glovebox; log mass

ops.name: Liners out, chamber cleaned (alloy change)
ops.interval: each alloy change (~1 h on an Aconity MINI, pain-points)

steps.step: Passivate condensate (slow air bleed, liner thermocouple watched) before vacuuming (pain-points P35)
Right side liner with its pull tab: 4 mm in off the wall, 21 mm forward (the ball screw leaves its slot), in to x 105, down 6 mm, out through the door
steps.detail: free along (-4, 0, 0) -> (-4, -21, 0) -> (-35, -21, 0) -> (-35, -21, -6) -> (-35, -541, -6); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: Back liner, upper right: 3 mm off the wall, forward over the ball screw, left 25 mm, out through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, -3, 0) -> (0, -40, 0) -> (-25, -40, 0) -> (-25, -560, 0); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: Back liner, lower right: forward under the ball screw, left 25 mm, out through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, -3, 0) -> (0, -40, 0) -> (-25, -40, 0) -> (-25, -560, 0); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: Recoater to the right end of its stroke (x +100), so the carriage block is clear of the left pieces
Left side liner with its pull tab (mirror of the right)
steps.detail: free along (4, 0, 0) -> (4, -21, 0) -> (35, -21, 0) -> (35, -21, -6) -> (35, -541, -6); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: Back liner, upper left: forward over the ball screw to y 54 (behind the dose chute), right 50 mm, out through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, -3, 0) -> (0, -40, 0) -> (50, -40, 0) -> (50, -560, 0); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: Back liner, lower left: forward under the ball screw, right 26 mm, out under the dose chute and through the door
steps.detail: free along (0, -3, 0) -> (0, -40, 0) -> (26, -40, 0) -> (26, -560, 0); tightest gap 0.36 mm to Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-frame from 5

steps.step: HEPA-vacuum the chamber, swab the coves, wipe the window side of the cover slide

ops.name: Recoater shaft feedthrough (Ferrotec magnetic-fluid unit) and servo
ops.interval: on leak-up rise or feedthrough wear

steps.step: Hand to the recoater servo, left of the chamber
steps.detail: blocked: from the front: forearm: Optics bridge posts, forearm: Laser guard panels; from above: forearm: Optics bridge, forearm: Laser guard panels

steps.step: Servo off its standoff
steps.detail: (-25, 0, 0) -> (-25, -520, 0) blocked by Optics bridge posts (60 x 60 x 5 square 6061 tube, 10 mm end after 193.0 mm; also tried (-25, 0, 0) -> (-25, 0, 520): Optics bridge (6061, 25 mm) at 145.0 mm; (-25, 0, 0) -> (495, 0, 0): Recoater motor standoff at 51.0 mm; (-25, 0, 0) -> (-545, 0, 0): Laser guard panels (1.5 mm aluminium) at 79.0 mm

steps.step: Motor standoff and bracket
steps.detail: (-10, 0, 0) -> (-10, -520, 0) blocked by Optics bridge posts (60 x 60 x 5 square 6061 tube, 10 mm end after 178.0 mm; also tried (-10, 0, 0) -> (-10, 0, 520): Optics bridge (6061, 25 mm) at 152.0 mm; (-10, 0, 0) -> (510, 0, 0): Process chamber body (6061-T6 through-fr at 98.0 mm; (-10, 0, 0) -> (-530, 0, 0): Guard frame (20 mm T-slot) at 54.0 mm

steps.step: Feedthrough unit and coupling off the left wall
steps.detail: free along (-45, 0, 0) -> (-45, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.3 mm to Recoater ball screw (M12, 10 mm lead)

steps.step: New packing; refit; leak check
Old plate out (as U4)
steps.detail: free along (0, 0, 20) -> (0, -520, 20); tightest gap 2.0 mm to Heater block S25 (6061-T6, bayonet socket)

steps.step: New plate in (reverse path); graphite foil; turned 60 deg to lock
Cool, vent; Z arm released (drops 45 mm away from the striker)
Release air on: both zero-point modules open (6 bar); round 6, the captive M6 are gone
Hand on the module handle's grip block, in front of the door
steps.detail: hand + forearm clear from the front

steps.step: Module out along its swap path (drop 40, forward 170, up 18, over the guard sill)
steps.detail: swap path clear; tightest gap 0.1 mm to Chamber floor plate (6061-T6, 20 mm, bolted under the frame; floor O-ring gland, module port, slots)

steps.step: New module in (reverse path) onto the dowels; release air off, the zero-point modules pull it home (hot-swap.md 3.2a); Z arm up; purge
Reservoir S out
steps.detail: free along (0, -125, 0) -> (0, -520, 0); tightest gap 0.85 mm to Metering base (6061, fluted roller over a 100 mm d

steps.step: Other reservoir on (reverse path); NFC read; the load cell tares
